what: S7 (1.98.0): T-0166/T-0167 integration tickets went done although their named route tests (e2e/login-route.spec.ts, e2e/dashboard-route.spec.ts) never existed; the build was broken (middleware matcher as a template string: next build failed) and typecheck/test checks were never run against a build; magic link redirected to /dashboard not /auth/callback; Failed-emails card and retry read a cookie sb-access-token that @supabase/ssr never sets; /dashboard crashed for any signed-in user (client-module function called on the server).
rule: An integration ticket is done only when its named route test file exists in the tree and passes; sync must refuse a tests path that is not a file, and a run touching routes must run next build.
fix: Hand-wrote real e2e (login, dashboard, retry, responsive) against local Supabase+Mailpit, added them to scripts/e2e-app.sh and CI; fixed redirect, session helper, matcher, server/client import.
